chunks: We are hastening to reward them for good deeds? No. They do not comprehend.
ai.seo_question: Why does God hasten the reward of disbelievers for their good deeds?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as 'hastening in punishment' rather than reward, illustrating how God accelerates the recompense for the disbelievers' minor good deeds to clear their account before the greater penalty of Hell. This concept underscores the divine wisdom behind the apparent prosperity of the unjust, serving as a test of spiritual perception for those who fail to recognize the transient nature of worldly ease. The phrase 'they do not know' highlights their cognitive blindness to the imminent reckoning that follows this accelerated settlement.
